o: Making one more unit, the 101st, adds about 4 to cost
why: Marginal cost is the extra cost of one more unit, close to where you are.
Only at one point: where average cost is at its lowest. MC crosses AC there.

q: If marginal revenue is positive, revenue is at its maximum.
why: Myth. Positive MR means selling more still raises revenue. Revenue is at its maximum where MR = 0.

q: C(q) = 500 + 3q². Find the marginal cost at q = 10.
why: The fixed cost 500 is a constant, so its derivative is 0. C'(q) = 6q, which gives 60.

q: Profit is at its maximum where…
why: While MR > MC, one more unit adds profit. At MR = MC there's no more to gain.
